universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). This breaks transforms. Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container. No generic `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Dark colors look good independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and lighter surface tones instead of heavy shadows (Linear style).
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers and overlays.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations and color relevant to the app style.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, selection states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

headings.style: Modern geometric (Söhne-style). Tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10. Avoid heavy borders. Use inner borders via inset box-shadow for premium depth.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal drop shadows. Rely on background lightness differences. For glows, use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)].
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10. Use for the sticky header or debate input area.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the hero section for a tactile feel.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tailwind scales: p-6, p-8, p-12. Generous padding inside cards (p-6 or p-8).
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Results page uses 2x2 grid for models: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.hero_section: Centered hero text max-w-3xl. High contrast. Followed by a massive, sleek text-area (input).
grids_and_layouts.debate_layout: High-density chat UI. Max width 4xl centered, distinct color-coded left/right or staggered bubbles.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,102,255,0.4)] rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-all duration-300 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full transition-all

text_area.style: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 focus-within:border-[#00E5FF]/50 focus-within:bg-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 text-xl transition-all shadow-inner text-white
text_area.instructions: Make it large ('Ask anything...'). Hide the default resize handle. Auto-expand height.

sliders.style: Shadcn Slider heavily customized. Active track uses Electric Blue. Thumb is pure white with a subtle glow.
sliders.layout: Labels on both ends (e.g., Accuracy <---> Creativity).

pill_selectors.style: ToggleGroup component from Shadcn. Rounded-full. Unselected: bg-transparent text-gray-400. Selected: bg-white/10 text-white shadow-sm.

cards.style: bg-[#0D1424] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden hover:border-white/20 transition-colors
cards.super_answer: Premium card. border border-[#0066FF]/50 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0066FF]/20 to-transparent relative. Include an inner glow or top border accent.

chat_bubbles.style: Rounded-2xl p-5 max-w-[85%]. Use model-specific border colors (left border 2px solid) or subtle background tints (e.g., bg-[#00E5FF]/10 text-white).

motion_interactions.hover: Subtle transform translate-y-[-2px] for cards. Button inner glows.
motion_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for Results Page cards (Framer Motion).
motion_interactions.page_transition: Smooth crossfade when switching from Homepage -> Results -> Debate.

hero_background.description: Abstract blue waves of glowing particles. Use as a very subtle, low-opacity (10-15%) absolute background in the hero section to set a premium tech mood.

3d_libraries_and_media: Use Lucide React for crisp, vector icons (Shield, Network, Sliders, Chat, Bot). No heavy 3D libraries needed to maintain Apple/Linear crispness. framer-motion is highly recommended for smooth transitions.
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you use .js and .jsx file extensions for React components. Do NOT use .tsx.
Setup routing (React Router) for Homepage (/), Results (/results), and Debate (/debate).
Brand Logo: Combine a minimalist Shield and Neural Network icon using Lucide React (e.g., <Shield className='w-6 h-6' /> next to <Network className='w-5 h-5' />).

Homepage: Build a majestic hero with a large, interactive 'Ask anything' textarea. Place the filters (2 sliders: Accuracy-Creativity, Quick-Deep; 2 pill groups: Audience, Output Format) beneath the textarea.
Results Page: Display 4 model responses in a grid, a 'Consensus Score' dial, 'Trust Score', Agreement/Disagreement lists, and a visually distinct 'Super Answer' premium card.
Debate Page: Implement a responsive group-chat layout showing back-and-forth between Model A, B, C, D to reach the consensus.
DO NOT use generic purple or standard SaaS blue gradients. Strictly use the Dark Navy/Electric Blue palette defined.
Ensure the 'See Full Debate' button stands out prominently in the Super Answer card.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for the dropdown menus or headers. Provide a solid dark navy or thick glassmorphic background.
Include 'data-testid' on all major inputs, buttons, sliders, and cards for testing.
